body:
We used an offline VM running a copy of our Agie Classic Cut 2S machine control. We imported CAMCraft’s ISO, SBR and SBL for the 40 × 20 mm punch. FORMALCHECK reported zero job errors with setup, reference and option warnings. GRAFICHECK showed four outward passes and the 1 mm separation. See #2999 for the later test of a conflicting saved quality and the corrected import workflow.

All controller runs were offline. No physical cut was made.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 025ed4760e592c3401859a66285457021a98341b -->
Needs changes before merge. This is a safety-tier review. The execution checks remain incomplete.

**Requested before merge**

1. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/post_dialog_tabs.rs:37` and `crates/ui/src/state.rs:4732`: Add screenshots of the current picker and successful receipt to the PR body. The body identifies its linked pictures as the earlier writer. It says the corrected pictures remain local. Those pictures do not show the current requested finish, zero working steps, or required control checks. Keep the before picture. Publish the current after pictures on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch and link them here.
2. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/post_dialog_tabs.rs:34` and `crates/ui/src/state.rs:4729`: Add UI tests for the Agie dialog and receipt. No UI test changes accompany these new branches. The application tests do not render the picker or execute the desktop receipt branch. Assert the job-folder label, requested finish, control-review text, and zero-step receipt through the UI harness. Also check the invalid-name and per-operation refusals. Current upstream `AGENTS.md` and `crates/ui/AGENTS.md` require structural assertions for UI changes.

**Local review results**

- Reviewed head `025ed4760e592c3401859a66285457021a98341b` against upstream main `36348cda60cdd8ff66810bbb87b12f4f0f80e6b9`.
- The trial merge completed without conflicts in `.claude/worktrees/review-2951`. GitHub still reports `CONFLICTING`. The PR needs a mergeable state before a green label.
- Not built: needs a maintainer look at `crates/app/Cargo.toml:42` and `crates/post/Cargo.toml:21` first. They add dependency edges for `tempfile`, `rustix` and `windows-sys`. Existing lockfile packages do not remove this review restriction. The PR-reviewer hard rule says to read a PR with added dependencies and not build it.
- Quick gate, UI lib tests, clippy, and heavy lanes: not run. The author's reported results are not independent review results.
- Safety mutations: not run under the same restriction. There are no independent red/green mutation results. A complete safety review still needs at least two mutation reruns after the dependency decision.
- Read the eight ISO lines, the SBR reference, all 78 SBL lines, and all 11 dispatcher refusal goldens. The ISO follows the nominal rectangle and closes at its entry point. The SBR and SBL match upstream's standalone encoder goldens byte for byte, including CRLF endings. The SBL uses `ASDELETE`, not automatic cut generation.
- `git diff --check --cached` passed for the trial merge.

**Extra suites run**

None. The dependency restriction also prevents these tests. The changed golden readers include application `agie_native` and post `script_agie_native`. Also run the related `recorded_streams`, application `conformance`, and standalone `agie_safe_setup` suites after the dependency decision. The effective PR diff adds no STEP fixture and changes no importer. The extra importer suites do not apply.

**Notes**

The writer validates the nominal contour before publication. It stages the three files together and uses a rename that refuses replacement. Its setup uses the encoder already on main. The reference-source question remains recorded in `docs/decisions/2945-native-agie-wire.md:11` and issue #2945. A maintainer must resolve that question before merge.

The author is `qsmits`. This review leaves the author's ready/draft state unchanged.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Two open items stand at head 025ed4760. This is not a disagreement.
1. Author: add the current screenshots to the PR body, and add UI tests for the new dialog branches. This is mkinney's change request.
2. Maintainer: the PR adds direct dependencies. The maintainer decides on them once the PR is otherwise ready and conflict-free.
No label change. The author's next push starts the re-check.

Returned this PR to draft for the review changes on 025ed4760. We will merge current main into the contributor branch, add UI tests for the picker and receipt, and prepare current screenshots from the synthetic punch example. The dependency decision remains with the maintainer.

Merged upstream main into the contributor branch. GitHub now reports `f92e67857` as mergeable. The PR body links the current synthetic picker and receipt and names the three new desktop tests.

On `45d6166e1`, 67 focused tests passed. Quick passed 1,032 of 1,033 steps. All 253 reached heavy steps passed. Commit `f92e67857` corrects the header test for the native post. All 27 focused tests and the official replay of the one failed quick step passed on that head.

Ready for a re-check (`/resolve-conflicts check`). Please clear the `conflicts` label if the re-check passes. The dependency and source decisions remain with the maintainer. The independent safety review is still open.

These are the two desktop screenshots requested in [the safety review](https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/pull/2951#issuecomment-7062281621). Both show the synthetic DEMO20 punch.

**1. Agie Post dialog.** The picker shows the job folder and the requested finish.

![Agie Post dialog showing the job folder and requested finish](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/qsmits/Camcraft/b2756a8b79b453dfe633ac4a7c1b31443b374c1e/after.png)

**2. Receipt after posting.** The receipt reports zero working steps and lists the checks required on the Agie control.

![Successful Post receipt showing zero working steps and the required control checks](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/qsmits/Camcraft/b2756a8b79b453dfe633ac4a7c1b31443b374c1e/receipt.png)

Open the full-size [picker](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/qsmits/Camcraft/b2756a8b79b453dfe633ac4a7c1b31443b374c1e/after.png) or [receipt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/qsmits/Camcraft/b2756a8b79b453dfe633ac4a7c1b31443b374c1e/receipt.png). The [earlier Generic ISO dialog](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/qsmits/Camcraft/b2756a8b79b453dfe633ac4a7c1b31443b374c1e/before.png) is available for comparison.

Not built - needs a maintainer look. This is a re-check of the safety-tier review on `025ed4760`. The read found no blockers. The read shows that the PR meets the two earlier requests.

**Earlier requests**

1. Screenshots: met. The PR body links the current picker (`after.png`) and receipt (`receipt.png`), and keeps the before picture. The images are on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch (commit `b2756a8b7`, files `after.png` and `receipt.png` only). The PR tree adds no image file.
2. UI tests: met in the read. The new file `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/agie_post.rs` has three harness tests:
   - `native_post_dialog_writes_three_files_and_reports_the_required_work_checks` asserts the `Job folder name` text input, the requested finish, the control-review text, the zero-step receipt, and the three output files byte for byte against the goldens.
   - `native_post_dialog_refuses_an_invalid_job_name_without_writing_files` asserts the name refusal and an empty output folder.
   - `native_post_dialog_refuses_per_operation_output_without_writing_files` asserts the per-operation refusal and an empty output folder.

   The tests assert labels, roles and commands. They do not assert a position, a size or a colour. These tests did not run in this review (see below).

**What changed since `025ed4760`**

- `45d6166e1` adds the UI tests above and registers the module in `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests.rs`.
- `f92e67857` changes only `crates/post/tests/comment_escape.rs`. The test now counts 19 text posts and expects one refusal from `agie-native`, with the native-directory diagnostic.
- `25e783b50` merges upstream main. The PR's production files (writer, dispatcher, posting, dialog, `.cps`, goldens, decision file) have no change except what main brought in.

**Results**

- Reviewed head `f92e67857acb8c405808069bd4123e9083658b72` against upstream main `5e76e6a14b366c510858bbbf660c06ca013c34d4`. GitHub reports `MERGEABLE`.
- Not built: needs a maintainer look at `crates/app/Cargo.toml:42` and `crates/post/Cargo.toml:21` first. They add dependency edges for `tempfile`, `rustix` and `windows-sys`. `Cargo.lock` adds no new package, only these edges. The PR-reviewer hard rule says to read a PR that adds dependencies and not to build it.
- Quick gate, `camcraft-ui` lib tests, clippy and heavy lanes: not run. The author's results (quick 1,032 of 1,033 steps on `45d6166e1`, the failed `comment_escape` step green on `f92e67857`) are not independent review results.
- Safety mutations: not run, for the same reason. A complete safety review still needs at least two mutation reruns after the dependency decision.
- Read: the new non-test code has no `unwrap()`, `expect()` or `panic!` (each hit is in a `#[cfg(test)]` module or a test file). Each new module has a provenance line. The fixed dialog text `AGIE_QN2 · Cold die steel 0001 · Berco Cut 0.25 mm` agrees with the only recipe that `crates/app/src/operation/agie_profile.rs:38` accepts.

**Extra suites run**

None, because of the dependency restriction. After the maintainer decision, run these suites:

- application: `agie_native`, `conformance`, `plasma_post_refusals`, `smoothing`;
- post: `script_agie_native`, `recorded_streams`, `comment_escape`, `agie_safe_setup`;
- `camcraft-ui` lib tests (`agie_post`).

The PR adds no STEP fixture and changes no importer. The extra importer suites do not apply.

**Notes (not blocking)**

- The reference-source question in `docs/decisions/2945-native-agie-wire.md:11` and issue #2945 stays with the maintainer.
- The dependency decision stays with the maintainer.

The author is `qsmits`. This review does not change the ready or draft state of the PR.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

A trial merge of `f92e67857` with upstream main at `6ffa808ae` found one conflict in `crates/post/tests/comment_escape.rs`. The conflict is in the test that checks header notes for each installed post. The production files merged cleanly.

Upstream commit `2415a90c0` adds a Klartext text post and checks its wrapped comments. This PR checks the Agie native-directory refusal separately. At refresh, the combined test must run the Klartext checks, count 20 text posts, and verify one native refusal. The dependency decision from the safety review remains open.

Returned this PR to draft after the `conflicts` label was applied. The trial merge with `6e1805bfd` still conflicts only in `crates/post/tests/comment_escape.rs`. The [previous comment](https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/pull/2951#issuecomment-7069378579) identifies the checks to preserve. The project's conflict procedure defers the branch refresh during the [v0.25.0 release cut](https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/pull/3266).

The conflict resolution is ready for a re-check at `bf4f3edafb6d67a74e6173f673ab6585f0238075`. The PR body records the contributor checks. The maintainer decision on the direct dependencies still precedes the independent safety review and its mutation tests. The Agie-CAM reference decision also remains with the maintainer.

Issue #2946 requested the Classic Cut 2S machine template. PR #2948 added the template and closed that issue. The decision file cites the issue. I updated the PR description to identify both references.
